description: Xianxia 150s Episode — 5 containers × 30s, arc=long_tail_late_break. Standing figure at snow pavilion sees breath plume, feels off-screen chime, releases jaw, distant mountain roar, snow silence returns.

performance_lock.breath_rule: visible white plume in cold dawn air; chest rise silent
performance_lock.breakdown_rule: release of grip on hilt, sleeve lowers slowly — never facial contortion
performance_lock.hand_task_rule: hand rests on sword hilt in formal placement
performance_lock.gaze_rule: gaze lands on the fallen leaf one full second before it lifts to the horizon

style_lock.lighting_base_ancient: dawn amber (2400K) angling in from frame-left, one hard source; ambient sky cool teal (6500K) at two stops under
style_lock.lighting_threshold: single beam of amber light through pine branches, mist visible in beam
style_lock.style_prefix_verbatim: Style: 8K IMAX. Photorealistic. Cinematography: telephoto compression from 100mm; painterly composed frames with strong negative space; silhouette against contre-jour backlight. Lighting: motivated dawn sun only, one hard source from frame-left, camera on shadow side, mist reads in the beam. Color: teal and amber, low saturation, skin preserved. Camera: cine lens with 1/8 diffusion and 2mm gold streak. 180° shutter motion blur. Skin: pore-level realism. Acting: sleeve moves before hand; breath visible as white plume. Physics: silk falls as silk; blade weight visible. Composition: golden ratio, negative space 60%. Continuity: identity holds across every cut. Technical: 24fps, 8K, no jitter. Audio: environmental SFX only. No music.

ancient_identity.name: Ling Xu
ancient_identity.wardrobe: dark indigo robe with pale silver embroidery at collar and cuffs; wide sash tied left; long straight black hair tied high with a jade pin; leather-wrapped hilt visible at left hip
features: one small mole below left corner of mouth
left ear-tip pierced with single silver stud

character_lock.continuity_anchor: jade pin in hair — never removed, never repositioned, catches amber light in every shot

prop_lock.sword_qingyun: 3.2ft straight jian, dark iron blade, jade pommel — resonates faintly when unsheathed; never drawn in this container
prop_lock.fallen_pine_leaf: single amber-brown pine needle cluster on wet stone — rotates one full turn during the shot; never multiplied
prop_lock.jade_pin: translucent pale green jade hairpin — catches amber rim light in every shot

sound_design_lock.ancient_signature: wind through bamboo at 0.5Hz, distant water drip on stone every 3-4s, silk sleeve friction on movement, breath work close mic
sound_design_lock.theme_motif: guqin single pluck — POST ONLY, not in prompt

@mes_bamboo_forest_dawn.text: vertical bamboo trunks in dawn mist; wet stone path underfoot; one shaft of amber light angling in from frame-left; a single fallen pine-needle cluster rotating slowly on still water in a stone basin at frame-right; negative space fills upper 60% of frame

diegetic: distant water drip on stone every 3-4s
silk sleeve friction on Ling Xu's turn
breath work — visible plume in cold air

@loc_bamboo_grove_dawn.descriptor_block: bamboo grove at dawn: dense vertical trunks 3-5m spacing; wet flagstone path bisecting frame-center-to-back; stone basin at frame-right 1.2m from center; mist layer at knee height and again at 3m; hard amber key from frame-left 30° elevation; no fill from camera side; shadows fall frame-right
@loc_bamboo_grove_dawn.geo_map:
LOCATION MAP
GEO SPATIAL LAYOUT (locked):
— BAMBOO TRUNKS: vertical, spacing 3-5m, frame-fill both sides
— STONE PATH: bisecting frame-center to back, wet flagstone
— STONE BASIN: frame-RIGHT, 1.2m from center, holds the rotating pine needle
— LING XU: standing on path, CENTER, facing frame-back (camera behind-shoulder)
— 180° AXIS: camera stays on the path's LEFT side, never crosses
— KEY LIGHT: hard amber sun from frame-LEFT at 30° elevation; mist reads in beam
— SHADOWS: fall frame-RIGHT; no fill from camera side

bridge_to_next.notes: first stillness under pavilion; breath meets cold
environmental witness; wind, snow layering; internal press begins
attention shifts to off-screen faint bell; head begins to move
long exhale + inner realization; distant mountain roar carried on wind

beats.label: first long visible breath plume peaks
wind picks up thread of snow
chime resolves; head not yet moved
distant mountain roar carried on wind
roar decays; silence carries into coda

performance_intents.inner_want: hold the ground of a decision already made
performance_intents.hidden: the decision was made against a teacher's wish

performance_intents.inner_want: let the silence do the work of speech
performance_intents.hidden: afraid the silence will crack her resolve

performance_intents.inner_want: let the leaf be the reason to stay still one second longer
performance_intents.hidden: using the leaf to postpone the turn toward the road

performance_intents.inner_want: release the grip and accept the leaving
performance_intents.hidden: the release is the actual grief
performance_intents.breakdown_moment: sleeve lowers 1cm on the hilt at T+27.5s
